correctness.rationale: The maximal open-neighborhood faces are exactly triangular triples Delta_i={i-1,i+1,i+n} and Gamma_{i,a}={(i-1,a),(i+1,a),(i,1-a)}. Generic vertex links are 3-edge paths and (f0,f1,f2)=(2n,4n,2n), so each connected component is a compact PL surface with boundary. Explicit triangle dual adjacencies and boundary cycles determine components and boundaries, with Euler characteristic zero yielding annulus or Möbius band as specified. Exceptions M4=K4 yields S², M6=K3,3 yields two disks, and P4 cube yields two tetrahedral boundaries. An independently written incidence/component calculator enumerated M/P n=4,...,10 and reproduced component/boundary counts, including two spheres for P4; finite checks support rather than prove generic n.
residual_risks: Explicit open (not closed) neighborhoods essential. Scope only the defined simple ladder graphs; no assertion for other complexes.
